scope.review_mode: One complete independent evidence and bilingual review. No author draft, shared source/editorial, production or Git writes.

sources.locations_read: Why Do We Cough/Transcript; Causes; Types; Diagnosis; Treating Cough (lines62-121)
sources.scope_and_limit: Public professional-association education. Page gives inconsistent acute-duration definitions in Causes versus Types; neither inconsistency is imported as a universal cutoff. No named medical reviewer was visible on this page.

sources.actual_author: MedlinePlus / A.D.A.M., reviewed by Frank D. Brodkey MD FCCM and team
sources.locations_read: Definition; Causes; Home Care; Contact a Professional; Office Visit; review footer (lines47-152)
sources.scope_and_limit: A.D.A.M. authored and physician reviewed, hosted by MedlinePlus; not NIH authorship. Its earlier contact threshold and broader emergency wording differ from NHS/CDC and must not be silently treated as identical.

sources.locations_read: Self-care; Pharmacist; GP/urgent advice; Appointment; Causes (lines15-98)
sources.scope_and_limit: UK public cough advice; acute course and duration review are different concepts. Pregnancy caution is explicit. Two NHS pages remain one authorship group.

sources.locations_read: Audience; Causes; Prevention; When to seek care; Treatment; How to feel better; OTC (lines25-117)
sources.scope_and_limit: Healthy people without underlying cardiac/pulmonary disease or immune impairment; pediatric fever and medicine advice retain their stated ages. Not a guideline for every cough.

sources.observed_version: Emergency box read; supplied metadata date not independently re-established
sources.scope_and_limit: General severe breathing warning signs. Same NHS authorship as cough and the additional NHS pages.

sources.locations_read: Symptoms opening; Low oxygen; High carbon dioxide; newborn signs; quick treatment (lines97-114)
sources.scope_and_limit: Physiology and urgency of acute respiratory failure; not a complete public symptom-by-symptom telephone triage protocol. Conservatively NIH family, not independent of every other NIH institute.

Official search text read. Direct chapter requests returned403 and official PDF timed out; no full-page fetch or PDF reading claimed. Adult/child acute URTI/bronchitis scope; professional prescribing recommendations.

sources.locations_read: Honey; Codeine; Antihistamines/decongestants; Bronchodilators; Corticosteroids; committee complication-risk discussion
sources.scope_and_limit: Official indexed source text, not a second NICE authorship group. Discusses systematic reviews and committee judgement. Historical product references do not establish current approval status.

sources.locations_read: Ways to treat; Giving children medicines; When to call a doctor (lines76-128)
sources.scope_and_limit: US pediatric public guidance. Distinguishes agency and manufacturer age wording. Ingredient duplication and adult-product cautions do not provide pregnancy evidence.

sources.actual_author: NIDDK, NIH; scientists and expert review
sources.locations_read: Eating habits; Foods to avoid; reference and expert-review footer (lines119-149)
sources.scope_and_limit: Adult GERD and individual symptom triggers; does not establish that diet treats all coughs. Refers to Badillo/Francis2014 and has NIH scientist/expert review. No pediatric dietary extrapolation.

sources.locations_read: What to Expect; Treatment Options; Managing Chronic Cough (lines59-86)
sources.scope_and_limit: Chronic cough context; same ALA authorship as general cough. Current full page was read beyond original indexed access. Do not use its US no-approved-medicine sentence as a newly verified regulatory claim.

additional_sources.support_scope: Separates small blood streaks from emergency amounts or associated cardiopulmonary symptoms. Counterevidence to the draft escalation rule.

additional_sources.actual_author: Mayo Clinic Staff; medical review listed2024-10-04
additional_sources.locations_read: Definition (lines263-267); When to see a doctor (lines298-300); references/review footer
additional_sources.support_scope: Independent support for emergency assessment of large or continuing bleeding. Does not independently reproduce every NHS combination trigger.
Independent NHS counterpart to CDC infant fever threshold/contact advice; not yet bound in author records. Route is UK111 for the threshold alone, not automatic999.

source_independence.NHS: All NHS national symptom pages count once. NICE is a separate guideline author, but shared upstream UK recommendations are possible, not proof of independent trials.
source_independence.ALA: General and chronic pages count once.
source_independence.ADAM: Licensed A.D.A.M. physician-reviewed encyclopedia, not NIH authorship; review names and URAC provider statement were visible.
source_independence.NIH: NHLBI and NIDDK conservatively share the NIH family; neither is combined here to fabricate two-source support of one action.
source_independence.NICE: Recommendations and evidence summary are one author. Indexed text has full relevant numbered passages; 403/PDF timeout prevents claiming a new full-page retrieval.
source_independence.shared_research: NICE identifies systematic reviews and trials. NHS/CDC/ALA pages generally do not expose all upstream evidence; independent prose cannot be presented as independent replication.

bilingual_review.overall: Core cause-dependent framework and numeric ages/durations match across Chinese/English.

needs_change.detail: 非常虚弱 is narrower than feeling very unwell.

bilingual_review.term_explanations: ACE inhibitor is given as a heart/blood-pressure medicine class; additional plain-language explanation can improve accessibility, but the larger issue is its source binding.

mece_review.result: Symptom entry preserved; cough is not itself a diagnosis. Infection, asthma, nasal drainage, reflux, irritation and medicines are differentiated; related disease IDs provide handoffs.
mece_review.limits: A category list is not proof all clinical causes are covered. No ICD coding or independent-disease coverage credit can be inferred from this symptom overview.

license_handling.result: Report stores identifiers, hashes, locator names and original audit judgements rather than copied source bodies.
license_handling.notes: A.D.A.M. is licensed restrictive content, not NIH public domain; ALA and NICE also retain rights. No source text corpus, tables or images saved. This review does not grant republication rights.

findings.issue: 当前当日评估分支没有为较多/持续咯血或咯血合并气短胸背痛另设急救升级，读者可能等待到出现极重呼吸表现。
findings.required_change: 分开少量血丝与较多/持续出血，补出血合并心肺警讯的急救路径；不以发绀、混乱或无法说话作为唯一升级条件。NHS与Mayo对大量/持续出血的共同范围明确；每个更细组合仍按实际来源定位。

findings.issue: very unwell被译为非常虚弱，中文缩窄为体力衰弱。
findings.required_change: 中英统一为整体病情明显不佳的白话表达；保留其当日评估条件，不增加无来源阈值。

findings.issue: 局部对应被整句通用assessment遮盖，尤其具体药物类别、机制、部分就诊问题及已读却漏绑的护理资料。
findings.required_change: 按每个独立医学问题缩小locator和assessment；现成材料能修的先补绑定，实用记录方法标为编辑组织，不冒充每个来源逐字给出的医学效果。

findings.issue: 关键行动或阈值存在单编写来源或两个来源各支持不同半句的情况；原作者已有部分诚实缺口说明，但不足以发布。
findings.required_change: 保留正确的临床条件，拆开主张后寻找真正支持同一行动的第二权威材料；不能仅将pending改成accepted。婴儿发热有本次找到的NHS补绑定候选。

findings.issue: 抗生素具体风险、复方重复成分、成人制剂与孕期提醒分别由不同原文承接。
findings.required_change: 逐风险记录支持范围；不把普通读标签建议当作所有风险的第二来源。保留儿童/孕期对象，不将地区年龄门槛混成一个通用值。

findings.issue: 药效与并发影响目前标explanation；特别是complications-2仅一个ALA来源，不能因类型标签绕过风险门槛。
findings.required_change: 按内容改为benefit/risk/action或拆分，保留已有双源药效支持，补齐慢性咳嗽影响的独立证据。

findings.issue: 三周/三至四周是不同用途的条件；ADAM还有更早联系建议。成人GERD材料不自动覆盖儿童，婴儿年龄和不同机构的用药门槛也不能互换。
findings.required_change: 按现有已标注的NHS/CDC对象保留时间条件并明确危险信号优先；对成人反流和婴儿阈值逐一保留人群/路径。地区差异记录不要求把所有数字堆进正文。

release_recommendation: Keep pending, no clinical signature or complete-coverage upgrade. Correct C01/C02 first; repair exact bindings and independent-evidence gaps before release. Correct single-source statements are not called false merely for lacking a second source.
